title: If you‘re not doing past papers… you‘re revising on hard mode. #engineering #engineeringstudent
transcript: Now, in terms of some actionable things you can do for your exams, do a few pass papers. If you've done all your tutorial problems, this is just a matter of honing your speed. You're pretty much just the exam technique. If you do four or five pass papers, you're going to be absolutely fine before your exam.
